description: Per-page join of GSC clicks and average position (aggregated by page, never per query), sessions and engaged rate, AI crawler fetches, AI referral sessions, index verdict, open findings and LCP. Search numbers are read live per page when the plan and daily budget allow; otherwise they fall back to the archived snapshot and position stays empty. Each row and the response say which source was used. Use it to find pages with traffic but no engagement, or pages AI reads that no human visits. Empty means no evidence, not no problems. Read-only. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_traffic_pages
title: Top pages by humans, AI and findings
